description: This file defines a 'Tab' class for managing browser tab interactions within the Playwright testing framework, including event handling, snapshot capturing, navigation, and console message processing.

classes.name: Tab
classes.description: Represents a browser tab, managing its lifecycle, events, console messages, snapshots, and interactions.

methods.name: collectConsoleMessages
methods.description: Collects console messages and page errors from a Playwright page.

methods.name: updateTitle
methods.description: Updates the stored title of the tab.

methods.name: navigate
methods.description: Navigates the tab to a specified URL, handling downloads and load state.

methods.name: captureSnapshot
methods.description: Captures a snapshot of the tab's current state, including URL, title, modal states, console messages, and downloads.
